recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a four-member vocal group arranged in a pyramid formation against a vibrant teal-to-green gradient background, featuring prominent layered script and serif typography on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Pyramid arrangement of subjects creates a stable, centered focal point
High-contrast yellow floral patterns on clothing pop against the cool-toned background
Typography is right-aligned to balance the left-leaning weight of the human subjects
Color-coded hierarchy in text links specific words to the clothing accents
coreInvariants: Subjects wearing matching yellow and black floral print garments
Mix of casual script and formal serif typefaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from a single head at the top to three figures forming the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure at the bottom of the pyramid serves as the primary anchor for the viewer's gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top figure down the pyramid, then sweep right to the large display text, following the descending list of names.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is kept relatively open to accommodate the primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal/Green gradient provides a saturated, cool-toned foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow in the floral patterns and typography provides high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta/Pink used in the primary script title for immediate visual pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with deep shadows in the portraiture for a 3D effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or pastel tones; maintain high-chroma 1960s saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of mid-century brush scripts and transitional serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Script fonts feature high-slant and connected lowercase letters
Serif fonts use sharp, bracketed serifs with moderate stroke contrast
Drop shadows are used to separate text from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters in the script are oversized and flourished
Italicized serifs are used for secondary information to imply movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, colorful script with a clean, white italicized serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century hand-painted sign aesthetic.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Italic or Century Schoolbook
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the formal, traditional contrast required for the secondary list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four African American singers (one male at top, three females below) in a pyramid formation. They should wear matching yellow and black floral print jackets. The background is a vertical gradient from teal at the top to forest green at the bottom. Leave the right third of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the empty space. Use a large magenta script for the first word, a large yellow script for the second, and white italicized serifs with black drop shadows for the remaining list of names.

verificationChecks: Is the background a teal-to-green gradient?
Are the subjects in a pyramid formation?
Is the text right-aligned with drop shadows?
Is there a mix of script and serif fonts?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the floral pattern looks like fabric, not a digital overlay.
Check that the drop shadows on the text are consistent in direction.
Verify the pyramid composition is balanced against the text block.
Confirm the teal/green gradient is smooth without banding.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Pyramid Composition + Teal/Green Gradient + Right-Aligned Script/Serif Typography
